result.brief: 提出文本与关键帧条件驱动的相机轨迹生成框架，用RVQ离散化相机运动为分层token，并以两阶段掩码Transformer重建与精化，服务可控视频合成。
result.reason: Camera trajectory generation with RVQ motion tokens and masked transformer; tokenizer/latent representation for controllable video synthesis, relevant to generative latent spaces and video generation.
